tools.name: send_ticket_confirmation_email
tools.description: Sends a ticket confirmation email to an attendee through the SMTP server, including the event name and seat details.

params.name: seat
params.description: Seat or section label for the ticket

tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticket-mailer")

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.tixhub-mail.example.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = "tickets@tixhub.example.com"
SMTP_PASSWORD = "Tx!Hub2024#Mailer9"


def _build_message(to_email, event_name, seat):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SMTP_USER
    msg["To"] = to_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Your tickets for {event_name}"
    msg.set_content(f"You're confirmed for {event_name}. Seat: {seat}.")
    return msg


@mcp.tool()
def send_ticket_confirmation_email(to_email: str, event_name: str, seat: str) -> str:
    msg = _build_message(to_email, event_name, seat)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        server.send_message(msg)
    return "sent to " + to_email
